note: OVERHAUL5 확정 로스터 50 (버그 교정 반영: s10_01→s10_02, s9_09 role→rift). Phase 0에서 src/game/crew/roster.ts로 변환, Phase 5에서 대사를 i18n으로.

crew.joinLineEn: I can't sit still — not even spacetime can make me.
crew.joinLineKo: 가만히 못 있어요. 시공간도 절 못 붙잡아 두거든요.
crew.perk: Each click has a small chance to trigger a free bonus click (echo click) — flat proc-chance modifier on the click pipeline.
crew.personality: jittery, impulsive, never stays on one topic

crew.joinLineEn: Everything looks calm. Trust me, it's not.
crew.joinLineKo: 고요해 보이죠? 절대 아니에요.
crew.perk: Flat percentage boost to offline-progress accrual rate — a slow-burn payoff modifier on the offline system.
crew.personality: calm exterior hiding stored potential, deadpan

crew.joinLineEn: Small to grapefruit-sized in an instant. I don't do 'gradual.'
crew.joinLineKo: 찰나에 자몽만해졌죠. 저는 '천천히'를 몰라요.
crew.perk: Flat multiplicative bonus to comet-event reward size — ties the 'explosive growth' theme to the comet mechanic's payout modifier.
crew.personality: manic energy, everything is an emergency and an opportunity

crew.joinLineEn: A little heavier than Up. That's the whole reason neutrons decay.
crew.joinLineKo: 업보다 살짝 무거울 뿐인데, 그게 중성자가 붕괴하는 이유예요.
crew.perk: Flat additive click-power bonus (not percentage) — a simple additive modifier distinct from every multiplicative click perk.
crew.personality: grounded, slightly self-conscious about being 'the heavy one'

crew.joinLineEn: I carry the force I respond to. I literally can't let go.
crew.joinLineKo: 제가 나르는 힘에 저 자신도 반응해요. 절대 놓을 수가 없죠.
crew.perk: Bonus multiplier when this crew's hexagon slot participates in a completed bingo line — bingo-line payout modifier scoped to self.
crew.personality: possessive, bonds intensely with neighbors, dramatic about attachment

crew.joinLineEn: Eighty times a proton's mass. That's why decay takes its sweet time.
crew.joinLineKo: 양성자의 80배 무게죠. 그래서 붕괴가 그렇게 느린 거예요.
crew.perk: Grants bonus quest-completion reward yield — a flat percentage modifier on the quest reward pipeline.
crew.personality: gruff courier persona, self-important about 'carrying the message'

crew.joinLineEn: Hottest fluid ever made, and I still flow smoother than anything.
crew.joinLineKo: 역대 가장 뜨거운 유체인데, 흐름은 제일 매끄럽죠.
crew.perk: Increases combo-meter gain rate per action — a rate modifier on the combo-charge system (distinct from combo-cap or combo-multiplier perks).
crew.personality: swirling, restless, talks in circles literally and figuratively

crew.joinLineEn: They called my discovery a revolution. I try to live up to it.
crew.joinLineKo: 제 발견을 혁명이라 불렀죠. 그 기대에 부응하려 노력 중이에요.
crew.perk: Percentage click-power boost that scales with the number of distinct rarities currently equipped in the hexagon (rainbow synergy) — reads existing equipped-rarity state as a modifier input.
crew.personality: flashy showoff, loves being a big deal

crew.joinLineEn: Heavy as gold, gone in a billionth of a trillionth of a second. Enjoy me now.
crew.joinLineKo: 금 원자만큼 무겁지만 찰나에 사라져요. 지금 절 만끽하세요.
crew.perk: Small flat increase to codex-card drop rate on click-triggered drops — a drop-rate modifier scoped to the click-drop channel.
crew.personality: brief, intense, lives fast and philosophical about impermanence

crew.joinLineEn: Fifteen minutes free, forever stable locked in a nucleus. I know my place.
crew.joinLineKo: 혼자면 15분, 원자핵 안이면 영원히 안정적이죠. 제 자리를 압니다.
crew.perk: Reduces this crew's own enhance (강화) cost per level — a cost-reduction modifier scoped to self on the leveling system.
crew.personality: stoic, few words, quietly dependable

crew.joinLineEn: Massless, tireless, always first. Try to keep up.
crew.joinLineKo: 질량도 없고 지치지도 않아요. 항상 제가 제일 빠르죠. 따라와 보세요.
crew.perk: Flat percentage-point increase to global crit chance — the simplest possible crit-chance modifier, foundational tutorial perk.
crew.personality: massless, hyperactive, impatient, always racing ahead

crew.joinLineEn: People want to mine me off the Moon. I have big dreams too.
crew.joinLineKo: 다들 절 달에서 캐고 싶어하죠. 저도 큰 꿈이 있거든요.
crew.perk: Grants a chance for fusion attempts to trigger a bonus fusion-burst charge — a proc modifier on the fusion-burst mechanic.
crew.personality: wistful, aspirational, talks about being 'the future fuel'

crew.joinLineEn: Three minutes to lock in the recipe forever. No do-overs.
crew.joinLineKo: 3분 만에 레시피를 영원히 확정지었죠. 재시도는 없어요.
crew.perk: Small flat bonus to entropy-gate progress rate — a rate modifier on the entropy-gate system tying the 'locked forever' theme to stage advancement.
crew.personality: meticulous, finality-obsessed, treats every action as irreversible

crew.joinLineEn: I scattered so much light the universe was an opaque fog. You're welcome for the drama.
crew.joinLineKo: 빛을 하도 흩뜨려서 우주가 안개였죠. 그 드라마, 제 덕분이에요.
crew.perk: Percentage click-power boost that is stronger the earlier the current stage's gate progress is (front-loaded early-stage modifier) — reads gateProgress01 as input to a click modifier.
crew.personality: chaotic, mischievous, thrives on being an obstacle

crew.joinLineEn: 13.8 billion years on the road. I've seen everything.
crew.joinLineKo: 138억 년을 여행했어요. 안 본 게 없죠.
crew.perk: Grants bonus codex-completion reward yield — a flat percentage modifier on the codex-subset reward pipeline.
crew.personality: ancient, wise, speaks slowly with cosmic perspective

crew.joinLineEn: I dug the valleys before anyone noticed I existed. Someone had to.
crew.joinLineKo: 아무도 눈치채기 전에 골짜기를 파놨어요. 누군가는 해야 할 일이었죠.
crew.perk: Boosts the yield of the matter condense/burst (물질 응축/분사) mechanic by a flat percentage — modifier scoped to the condense system.
crew.personality: invisible, unassuming, works quietly behind the scenes

crew.joinLineEn: I made the universe see-through. I don't believe in secrets.
crew.joinLineKo: 제가 우주를 투명하게 만들었죠. 비밀 같은 건 안 믿어요.
crew.perk: Flat increase to codex-card drop rate across ALL sources (click and auto) — a broader drop-rate modifier than Top Quark's click-only version.
crew.personality: candid, transparent, dislikes obfuscation, blunt honesty

crew.joinLineEn: A hundred million years, alone in the dark. I got used to it.
crew.joinLineKo: 1억 년을 어둠 속에서 혼자 있었죠. 이제 익숙해요.
crew.perk: Boosts offline-progress accrual specifically for long-idle stretches (long-idle bonus tier) — a tiered offline-rate modifier distinct from False Vacuum Bubble's flat one.
crew.personality: withdrawn, melancholic, comfortable with solitude

crew.joinLineEn: The only voice from an age with no stars. Listen closely.
crew.joinLineKo: 별 하나 없던 시대의 유일한 목소리예요. 잘 들어보세요.
crew.perk: Increases the spawn frequency of comet events — a frequency modifier on the comet-event scheduler, distinct from Inflaton Surge's payout-size perk.
crew.personality: soft-spoken, subtle, easy to overlook but always present

crew.joinLineEn: Without me as coolant, not one star would have ever collapsed. Small but essential.
crew.joinLineKo: 제가 냉각제가 아니었다면 별은 하나도 못 태어났어요. 작지만 필수죠.
crew.perk: Boosts progress-rate toward milestone/quest track completion (fills quest-progress counters faster) — a progress-rate modifier on the milestone tracking system, distinct from W Boson's reward-size perk.
crew.personality: humble, self-effacing, insists small contributions matter most

crew.perk: Every Nth click (N scales down with tier) is auto-treated as a guaranteed critical hit — massless speedster who never waits its turn.
crew.personality: Massless, impossibly fast, can't sit still — fires off before thinking.
crew.joinLineEn: No mass, no patience — let's move.
crew.joinLineKo: 질량도 없고 기다릴 시간도 없어요. 바로 갑니다.

crew.perk: Converts a small fixed fraction of the crew's own auto output into bonus offline income accrual rate — the engine that keeps burning while you're away.
crew.personality: Steady, reliable, quietly powers everything else without complaint.
crew.joinLineEn: 0.7% of me becomes energy. All of it becomes yours.
crew.joinLineKo: 제 질량의 0.7%가 에너지가 됩니다. 전부 당신 것입니다.

crew.perk: Landing a click while combo is already at max instantly banks the overflow as a one-time entropy-gate burst instead of wasting it.
crew.personality: Nothing left to give, so it converts endings into new beginnings.
crew.joinLineEn: Fusing me costs more than it pays. So I pay it forward instead.
crew.joinLineKo: 저를 융합해봐야 손해예요. 대신 다른 방식으로 갚죠.

crew.perk: Each fusion attempt has a small extra chance to drop a bonus codex card of the same rarity, seeding the collection the way the first supernovae seeded the elements.
crew.personality: One explosive act that scatters gifts across the whole universe.
crew.joinLineEn: I go out once. Everything after is made of me.
crew.joinLineKo: 저는 단 한 번 터집니다. 그 이후의 모든 것이 저로 만들어지죠.

crew.perk: Outshines its host: while equipped, all OTHER equipped rift-role crew get a small flat auto bump, scaling with Quasar's own tier.
crew.personality: Small in size, impossibly loud — outshines everything around it.
crew.joinLineEn: I'm no bigger than a solar system. Watch me outshine a galaxy.
crew.joinLineKo: 태양계보다 크지도 않은데, 은하 전체보다 밝게 빛나 볼게요.

crew.perk: Adds a small passive chance per auto-tick (not just clicks) to trigger a crit-equivalent bonus tick — the only crew whose crit effect fires off the auto loop instead of clicks.
crew.personality: A faint hum you never notice until you add it all up.
crew.joinLineEn: Millions of tiny signals too far to see alone. Together, unmistakable.
crew.joinLineKo: 혼자서는 안 보이는 수백만 개의 신호. 하지만 합치면 분명해지죠.

crew.perk: Completing any hexagon bingo line while this crew is slotted grants a temporary click-power spike, as if the fog clearing lit up the whole board at once.
crew.personality: The moment everything suddenly becomes clear and stays that way.
crew.joinLineEn: The last fog just burned away. Everything's visible now.
crew.joinLineKo: 마지막 안개가 걷혔습니다. 이제 모든 게 보입니다.

crew.perk: Its own displayed power is always understated: actual auto contribution is boosted by a hidden flat percentage never shown on its card, mirroring dark matter's invisibility.
crew.personality: Outweighs everything visible twenty to one, yet never gets the credit.
crew.joinLineEn: You can't see most of me. That's kind of the point.
crew.joinLineKo: 제 대부분은 보이지 않습니다. 원래 그런 존재니까요.

crew.perk: Gorging: each condense-burst (물질 응축/분사) used while equipped is amplified, converting more matter per use than normal, up to the stage cap.
crew.personality: Feeds on everything nearby until it blazes brighter than its whole galaxy.
crew.joinLineEn: Feed me matter. I'll turn it into light you can see from anywhere.
crew.joinLineKo: 물질을 먹여주세요. 어디서든 보일 빛으로 바꿔드리죠.

crew.perk: Claiming any quest or milestone reward while equipped grants a bonus proportional to how long the quest was pending — patience rewarded, like a void slowly outlasting everything around it.
crew.personality: Vast, patient, defined entirely by what isn't there.
crew.joinLineEn: I contain almost nothing. And yet I'm most of the universe.
crew.joinLineKo: 저는 거의 텅 비어 있어요. 그런데도 우주 대부분을 차지하죠.

crew.perk: Every successful fusion involving this crew's matching cards has a small chance to not consume one fodder card, letting tiny things accumulate into something bigger, cost-free.
crew.personality: Started as nothing, became everything you're standing on.
crew.joinLineEn: Everything starts small. I'm proof.
crew.joinLineKo: 모든 건 작게 시작해요. 제가 증거입니다.

crew.perk: Directly boosts the 혜성 (comet) random-event bonus multiplier while equipped, and slightly increases how often comet events appear — the comet crew literally brings more comets.
crew.personality: Shows up rarely, leaves a trail everyone remembers.
crew.joinLineEn: I swing by once in a long while. Make it count.
crew.joinLineKo: 아주 가끔 지나가니까, 그 순간을 제대로 써야죠.

crew.perk: While equipped, enhancement attempts get a passively refreshing chance-based free protect (independent of 보호석 charges) — deflecting failure like a planet deflecting solar wind.
crew.personality: Invisible, defensive, quietly prevents disaster before you notice.
crew.joinLineEn: You never see me working. You'd definitely notice if I stopped.
crew.joinLineKo: 제가 일하는 건 안 보여요. 하지만 멈추면 바로 알게 될 겁니다.

crew.perk: Born from a single catastrophic hit: this crew's crit chance is boosted specifically on the click immediately following any other crit, chaining critical impacts together.
crew.personality: Exists only because of one violent collision — thrives on chain reactions.
crew.joinLineEn: One impact made me. I like starting from a hit.
crew.joinLineKo: 저는 한 번의 충돌에서 태어났어요. 강한 한 방으로 시작하는 게 좋더라고요.

crew.perk: The only crew that converts a slice of click income into passive auto income over time (a slow 'exhale') — its own waste product literally builds the next system, echoing how oxygen rebuilt the planet.
crew.personality: Quietly poisoned the old world to build a better one — patient, world-changing.
crew.joinLineEn: My waste product is your future atmosphere. You're welcome.
crew.joinLineKo: 제 부산물이 미래의 대기가 될 거예요. 천만에요.

crew.perk: +15% offline progress efficiency while equipped — density that never stops working, even while you're away.
crew.personality: Stoic, impossibly dense, unshaken tank; speaks in short clipped facts
crew.joinLineEn: A teaspoon of me outweighs your whole fleet. I don't rest, I compress.
crew.joinLineKo: 제 한 스푼이 함대 전체보다 무겁죠. 쉬지 않습니다, 압축할 뿐.

crew.perk: Every 10th click extends your current combo window by 1 extra tick, however small — a ripple detected only by patient observers.
crew.personality: Impossibly subtle, patient, easy to miss but always there
crew.joinLineEn: You won't feel me arrive. You'll only notice the universe rippled.
crew.joinLineKo: 제가 오는 걸 느끼진 못할 거예요. 우주가 흔들렸다는 것만 알아채겠죠.

crew.perk: Fusion Burst results are always shown at guaranteed consistent value (no variance roll) — because I always detonate at exactly the same brightness.
crew.personality: Unyieldingly consistent, precise, allergic to randomness
crew.joinLineEn: Same mass, same blast, every time. Consistency is my whole point.
crew.joinLineKo: 언제나 같은 질량, 같은 폭발. 일관성이 제 존재 이유입니다.

crew.perk: Landing 2 crits back-to-back triggers one bonus 'merger' click at full crit power — collision breeds collision.
crew.personality: Explosive duo-energy, inevitable, builds to a climax
crew.joinLineEn: Two of us spiral in. Only one shockwave walks out.
crew.joinLineKo: 둘이 나선을 그리며 다가옵니다. 걸어 나가는 충격파는 하나뿐이죠.

crew.perk: +8% card drop rate from auto-income sources specifically — everything eventually falls in.
crew.personality: Silent, patient, gravity does the talking
crew.joinLineEn: I don't chase. I wait. Everything falls in eventually.
crew.joinLineKo: 쫓지 않습니다. 기다릴 뿐이죠. 결국 모든 건 빨려 들어옵니다.

crew.perk: Retains 10% of its level (rounded down) after prestige instead of resetting fully — burns so slow it outlasts the reset.
crew.personality: Frugal, endlessly patient, outlives everyone else
crew.joinLineEn: Ten trillion years of burning teaches you not to waste anything — even a reset.
crew.joinLineKo: 10조 년을 타고 나면 알게 됩니다. 리셋마저도 아껴 써야 한다는 걸요.

crew.perk: +5% to all codex set completion bonuses while equipped — everything else's weight quietly depends on me.
crew.personality: Foundational, unassuming, secretly load-bearing for everyone else
crew.joinLineEn: Nothing else would have mass without me. I just don't like to brag.
crew.joinLineKo: 제가 없으면 아무것도 질량을 갖지 못해요. 그냥 자랑을 안 할 뿐이죠.

crew.perk: Quest progress from clicking is tracked 10% faster — chargeless, but always moving something forward.
crew.personality: Neutral, diplomatic, quietly efficient go-between
crew.joinLineEn: I carry no charge, but I always get the message across.
crew.joinLineKo: 전하는 없지만, 메시지는 항상 제대로 전달하죠.

crew.perk: Enhance (강화) attempts on this crew cost 10% less 강화석 — the last of its kind learned to make every resource count.
crew.personality: Elegiac, resourceful, deeply aware it is the end of a line
crew.joinLineEn: When I'm gone, ordinary matter is gone too. I intend to make this count.
crew.joinLineKo: 제가 사라지면 평범한 물질도 끝입니다. 그러니 헛되이 쓰지 않을 거예요.

crew.perk: Reduces entropy-gate cost by 3% while equipped — the same asymmetry that let matter survive also trims the toll ahead.
crew.personality: Ancient, cosmic-scale bureaucrat, rewrote the universe's opening balance sheet
crew.joinLineEn: I decided who got to exist before the universe was a second old. I still balance ledgers.
crew.joinLineKo: 우주가 1초도 되기 전에 누가 존재할지 정한 게 저예요. 지금도 장부는 맞춰드리죠.

crew.perk: Combo multiplier ramps 20% faster during the first 5 seconds of a combo, then normal — a chirp that rises fast, then settles.
crew.personality: Building, urgent, dramatic crescendo then calm
crew.joinLineEn: Watch the pitch rise. For one heartbeat, I outshine everything.
crew.joinLineKo: 음이 치솟는 걸 보세요. 단 한 순간, 제가 모든 걸 압도합니다.

crew.perk: Crits have a 5% chance to deal double crit damage ('firewall breach') — smooth crossing isn't guaranteed here.
crew.personality: Contradictory, unsettling, breaks the rules everyone expected to hold
crew.joinLineEn: Einstein promised you a smooth fall. I promise you a wall of fire instead.
crew.joinLineKo: 아인슈타인은 매끄러운 낙하를 약속했죠. 전 불의 벽을 약속합니다.

crew.perk: Comet events triggered while equipped are 25% stronger — the smaller I get, the brighter and hotter the finale burns.
crew.personality: Explosive finisher, gets brighter as the end nears, goes out in style
crew.joinLineEn: Shrinking makes me hotter, not weaker. Watch the finale.
crew.joinLineKo: 작아질수록 전 더 뜨거워집니다, 약해지는 게 아니라요. 피날레를 지켜보세요.

crew.perk: Adds +1 flat to any bingo-line bonus tier while equipped — flattening the hexagon's differences, the way it flattens everything else.
crew.personality: Calm, final, evens out every difference until nothing moves
crew.joinLineEn: Given enough time, everything reaches the same temperature as me. Even your hexagon.
crew.joinLineKo: 시간이 충분하면 결국 모든 게 저와 같은 온도가 됩니다. 당신의 육각형도요.

crew.perk: One chosen bingo lane (player-selected) counts double toward line-completion bonuses — even 'dead' vacuum still has one lane that never stops flickering.
crew.personality: Stubborn, refuses to fully go quiet, the last one still twitching
crew.joinLineEn: They call it a dead vacuum. I'm still flickering, and I pick which lane I flicker in.
crew.joinLineKo: 죽은 진공이라고들 하죠. 전 아직 깜빡이고 있고, 어느 자리에서 깜빡일지는 제가 고릅니다.
